posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Upon returning from PAX, I thought I’d check to see if there was much about Sentinels on the youtube…

There is. So I’m compiling them here! Enjoy!

The Drive-Thru Review: http://youtu.be/BoUwiJCqTUE

Andy Arenson does an overview: http://youtu.be/YtM4idwHEK4

The guys from The Spiel interview Christopher and Adam at Gen Con 2011: http://youtu.be/8BdC-sAUUOM

Tom Vasel does his Dice Tower review: http://youtu.be/eO6CTK3nV38

Drakkenstrike’s amazing comic-book style animated video: http://youtu.be/KM3FFk9jNvY

The Down The Road show interviewed Christopher at the Chicago Comic Con: http://youtu.be/e-A2fsyS6pE

Know of any I missed? Post them here!
